decisions.reason: The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY that captures the accepted Sales Navigator-to-Apollo-to-HubSpot transfer path, automatic HubSpot export, and arrival time. The source enrichment decision requires no additional transfer-state update or removal.
Automatic Apollo email enrichment does not resolve or change how existing CRM records are identified or where duplicate status is displayed.
The accepted enrichment workflow does not determine whether LinkedIn profile URLs or Sales Navigator URLs are transferred to the CRM.
The source decision concerns Apollo enrichment and export into HubSpot, not the separately deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization.
Email information obtained through Apollo enrichment is contact data, not email or LinkedIn conversation history displayed on a HubSpot lead record.
The Apollo enrichment workflow does not change silent-lead recirculation, MeetAlfred follow-up export, or the requirement to avoid manual campaign cleanup.
The mention of email information in Apollo enrichment is unrelated to warming a campaign domain or mailbox.
The accepted Apollo enrichment alternative does not alter the obligation to provision a campaign domain.
The source decision changes the Apollo enrichment workflow and does not modify MeetAlfred account or platform configuration.
The accepted Apollo-to-HubSpot enrichment workflow does not require any change to the separate Zapier account configuration requirement.
